verdict: Meta went dark five days ago; leads have stalled and intake needs fixing.
narrative: Meta advertising produced zero spend and zero leads from September 9 through 13, which explains the 58% drop in leads over the most recent seven days. Over the full 28-day window you received 30 leads at $46.95 cost per lead, all from Meta — but 24 contacts logged in your CRM produced zero pipeline opportunities, meaning leads are arriving and not converting, a gap that exists independent of ad volume. Ads are being reactivated and the focus is shifting immediately to the intake process to ensure leads are reached and moved forward. Alongside that, SMS automation and call access — both needed to close the contact-rate gap — are being stood up now. Next period you should see lead flow resume as spend returns, and the pipeline conversion number should begin to move as intake is corrected.
